bullets.text: Minister Kumar inaugurated completed project works worth Rs 1.08 crore including a 70-bed modern health center in the Adyar zone, and the office should monitor its public utilization.
Public blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam for 30 minutes due to a five-hour power outage, and the district team must coordinate with utilities to prevent recurring outages.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss alleged corruption in the Pallikaranai marshland project and demanded Chief Minister Joseph Vijay intervene, which the office should monitor closely.
Avadi police arrested a mother and her paramour for allegedly sexually harassing a 15-year-old girl, and the district administration must ensure victim support and a thorough investigation.
Collector S. Kavitha and MLAs launched the Vetri vegetable bundle scheme to sell subsidized vegetables in Thiruvallur, and the team should track distribution efficiency.
Police arrested three Andhra men for a major burglary at a document writer's house near Pallipattu after a year, recovering 86.5 sovereigns, and the local administration should note the breakthrough.
Tamil Nadu won three medals at the World Para Arm Wrestling Championship featuring nine players from Ponneri, and the district team should felicitate the achievers.
The Tamil Nadu government signed an MoU with ELCOT and IITM Pravartak at the Secretariat on November 5 to establish a dedicated AI data center, and the portfolio team must oversee implementation.
MeitY approved 12 projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme with a Rs 7,503 crore investment, presenting expansion opportunities for the state's digital infrastructure.
The Tamil Nadu government constituted a 20-member Investment Promotion Commission headed by the Chief Secretary to promote investments, which the IT portfolio should engage with.
TVK's IT wing questioned the DMK over alleged fake authors and publishers purchasing books for Periyar Arivuvalagam in Coimbatore, and the political team should monitor fallout.
Kerala Law Academy invited research papers for its 33rd International Seminar on Good Governance and Artificial Intelligence in the Digital Era, which relevant departments may share.
